question: Execute C Site Lotus 4v4 (smallest site, 4 entries), 40s, you are Jett at C Main. How do you open the entry on such a tight site?

options.label: Layered execute: Cloudburst cuts one sightline, grouped entry via C Main + C Link simultaneously to overwhelm the site
options.explication_courte: C is the smallest site with 4 entries and few DEF spots: hitting from two access points simultaneously with a smoke cutting the key angle disperses DEF and creates trades.

options.label: Dash Jett solo through C Main to create the opening first and let the team follow
options.explication_courte: A dash-entry from Jett takes space quickly and creates an opening, but on a small site with 4 entries a solo dash that is not traded can put you in a 3v4 immediately.

sources_option.citation: A Jett dash entry takes space fast on Lotus, but on the tight C site a solo dash that isn't traded can drop the team into a man-down execute.

options.label: Dry-push in file through C Main without util to conserve abilities for later
options.explication_courte: Entering dry in a file on a small site gives DEF a shooting gallery: each player peeks the same angle one by one, exactly what C holds are set up to punish.

sources_option.citation: C Site's few holding spots punish players entering one lane single-file; without utility to break the sightline, defenders pick attackers off in a line.

options.label: Refuse the entry and play for the end of round in a default without hitting the site
options.explication_courte: Refusing to enter at 40s in a 4v4 full-buy loses the round by default: you surrender attack initiative without creating any plant threat, handing the round to the DEF.

sources_option.citation: Failing to commit an execute at even numbers with the round clock running cedes attacker initiative and hands the round to the defense without a plant threat.

explication_longue:
Situation: execute C Site Lotus in 4v4, 40 seconds, you are Jett at C Main with Cloudburst, Updraft, Tailwind. C is the smallest site on the map with 4 entries.

C Site entry principle: small site, multiple entries, few hiding spots for DEF. The correct execute exploits the entry options rather than funneling through one. Cloudburst cuts the primary sightline (e.g. the C Main pillar angle), while your team enters simultaneously through C Main AND C Link - two entry points at once forces DEF to choose which to hold and creates a trade on whichever they pick.

Jett solo dash (acceptable) takes space quickly and can open an entry, but a solo dash on a tight site that goes untraded puts you in immediate trouble. Dry-push in file (costly) is the worst possible entry pattern on a small site: everyone peeks the same angle in sequence and DEF drop them one by one. Refusing to enter at 40s (mistake) concedes the round without a fight.

Estimated elite distribution: ~54% layered execute (smoke + simultaneous dual-entry), ~22% Jett dash-entry solo, ~16% dry-push in file (costly), ~6% refuse entry (mistake).

sources.citation: C Site is arguably the smallest site in the game with very few places to hold but four entry points, so overwhelming it from multiple accesses is the attacker's edge.
Executing C on Lotus rewards layered utility and simultaneous entries; a Jett dash takes space but must be traded on such a tight site.
Entries win by breaking sightlines and taking space together; single-file dry pushes into a small site are picked off by defenders holding the lane.

_gaps.incertitude: Estimations depuis guides Lotus (ibuypower, upforge, mobalytics) ; la frequence execute-layered vs dash-Jett depend du tempo et de la compo, sans dataset public.
Le dash Jett solo (acceptable) peut etre optimal dans une compo dash-entry rapide avec bon trade ; la frontiere depend du plan d'equipe non fixe ici.
Positions x/y approximatives sur C Site Lotus (viewBox 1000x1000, zones de maps.ts) ; le nombre exact de DEF stackes sur C est inconnu (4v4 mais repartition non fixee).
